name: Lake Bamboo Flute
description: Breath-first bamboo flute with velocity-driven blowing pressure. Air starts immediately, then the bore tone builds. Soft/medium notes settle on the played pitch; firm attacks briefly overblow and fall back; hard blows favor the octave while held. Ground and octave families overlap and exchange strength irregularly near the register boundary, then stabilize away from it. Unequal resonance memory preserves the lower tone through transitions. A recording-informed modal-envelope approximation, not a full air-jet simulation. Best E3–E5, playable to D6. Five compatible controls and dry Stereo Output.
